programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Se encuentra un cadáver con una herida de bala en la cabeza; el arma se encuentra al lado de la víctima. Parece suicidio, pero ¿podría ser un asesinato?

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: En San Diego, California, un asesino ha dejado rastros. Los detectives deben clasificar estas pistas pequeñas para probar el asesinato.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Generalmente, una víctima nunca predice peligro cuando el perpetrador es un amigo o un amante. La ciencia y la evidencia microscópica pueden desenmascarar a estos asesinos y encontrar justicia para quienes son matados por el amor

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Tres cabellos... fibras microscópicas... una bolsa de basura común arrancada de un rollo. Pistas aparentemente pequeñas e insignificantes se convierten en el testigo silencioso de una víctima.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: En la mayoría de los homicidios, la policía confía en el motivo para perseguir a un asesino. Pero cuando el asesino es un extraño, el crimen puede quedar sin resolver por muchos años.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: En investigaciones criminales, una pista simple puede conectar un sospechoso al crimen. La suciedad en los zapatos, neumáticos, ropa, o una pequeña pieza de plástico puede ubicar la escena del crimen.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: La resolución de delitos puede comenzar con la intuición visceral, pero la ciencia avanzada proporciona pruebas irrefutables a los investigadores.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Marcado de herramientas: una herramienta utilizada para cometer un delito a menudo puede ser la misma herramienta utilizada para resolverlo.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Algunas de las mejores pistas provienen de los lugares menos probables. Los crímenes más difíciles se han resuelto y los delincuentes han sido traicionados a través de la evidencia proporcionada por insectos, botellas de cerveza.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Un propietario nuevo de Nueva York recibe más de lo que esperaba cuando una inspección de la casa revela un cadáver momificado. Por décadas, el crimen no había sido descubierto. La víctima desaparecida, y el asesino impune.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Semanas pasan cuando los investigadores forenses encuentran pistas pequeñas, solo para encontrar lo que temen en su propio patio trasero.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Nuevas técnicas forenses utilizadas para resolver casos antiguos: los avances en ciencia y tecnología alientan a detectives a revisar el pasado con la esperanza de responder preguntas que han quedado sin respuesta y resolver crímenes.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Aproximadamente 1.8 millones de estadounidenses desaparecen cada año. Algunos son fugitivos que vuelven a casa, pero otros simplemente desaparecen. Sospechando juego sucio, los investigadores recurren a los forenses para encontrar a los desaparecidos.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Una mujer es encontrada muerta en la debajo las escaleras del sótano. Cuando los detectives observan el accidente, comienzan a cuestionar la secuencia de eventos. A veces, las primeras impresiones enmascaran la verdad.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: El concepto de George Orwell de "gran hermano" permanece en el ámbito de la ficción. Pero a medida que la tecnología se hace a una parte mayor de nuestras vidas, es más difícil hacer un movimiento sin dejar un rastro electrónico.

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Rugrats

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.desc: Lili está preocupada porque no es tan perfecta como debería y termina descubriendo que disfruta ser quien es, más que ser quien debería ser.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Viaje al reino de los Duelos!
programme.desc: Yugi sacrificia sus propia estrellas para que Joey viaje en el bote yendo al Reino de los Duelos, para que pueda batirse en duelo para guardar la visión de su hermana, Serenity.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Entrada al nido de las avispas!
programme.desc: Pegasus anuncia que hay muchos secretos raros que aseguran que su torneo máximo va ser como nada que se ha visto antes. ¡Yugi tendrá que resolver y dominar las reglas del concurso para sobrevivir!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despues que Yugi vence los primeros monstruos de duelos de Weevil, el engañoso revela un truco final, ¡el Gran Moth hambrienta, que le sube el poder con cada turno! ¿Podrar Yugi vencer esta monstruosidad lada antes que lo destruya a él?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey valientamente acepta un duelo contra una duelista veterana, Mai. Pero cuando Mai demonstra una abilidad síquica espantosa, ¡Joey tendrá que resolver la estrategia secreta de Mai antes que él le caiga victima!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Un duelista pescador, Mako, reta a Yugi a un duelo al lado del mar. Yugi lleva una gran desventaja porque no puede ver los monstruos marinos de Mako abajo del mar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La junta directiva de KaibaCorp tiene intención de quitarle el poder de la compañía a Kaiba y entregarsela a Pegasus si Yugi es eliminado del torneo. Mokuba, el hermano menor de Kaiba, ¡reta a Yugi a un duelo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se enfrenta en duelo contra un doble magio de Seto Kaiba. Pero con sus mejores cartas en el fondo del mar, ¡Yugi tendrá que descubrir una nueva estrategía para sobrevivir a los ataques de Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules del Kaiba Fantasma!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después que Yugi logra vencer el Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules, dos copias más del monstruo salen a battalar! El verdadero Kaiba corre a ayudar a Yugi ganar el duelo, ¿pero llegará a tiempo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decide batirse en duelo contra Rex Raptor, sin ninguna ayuda de sus amigos. Los dinosaurios de Rex Raptor acaban con los monstruos mejores de Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duela valientamente, pero Rex Raptor ha sortado su arma secreta: ¡Dragón Negro de Ojos Rojos! Ahora Joey tendrá que determinar el secreto del regalo de Yugi, sin la ayuda de Yugi. Si no, ¡tendrá que ir de la Riena de los Duelos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Espíritu Maligno de la Sortija
programme.desc: Un compañero de escuela de Yugi, Bakura, poseído por la energía de su Sortija Milenio, ¡atrapa a Yugi y sus amigos en el Reino de las Sombras donde se convierten en las propias cartas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La Luz al Final del Túnel
programme.desc: Un duelista llamado Panik, que está trabajando por Pegasus como eliminador de otros duelistas, le hace trampa a Mai y le quita todos sus estrellas. Yugi prometa ganarlas para trás y reta a Panik a un duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A pesar de una desventaja grandisima, Yugi proclama valientamente que va a vencer a Panik en solamente tres turnos. ¿Está Yugi blofeando, o tendrá él una estrategia secreta?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: En el Reino de los Duelos, Kaiba se enfrenta a un duelo contra Pegasus! ¿Ha cambiado Kaiba desde su duelo contra Yugi, o sigue siendo el mismo duelista despiadadado de antes?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La Arena de las Almas Perdidas, Primera Parte
programme.desc: La banda del Bandido Keith secuestra a Joey y lo llevan a una cueva secreta que tiene adentro un cementerio de duelos. Mientras Yugi y sus amigos lo buscan, Joey tiene que afrentarse a los monstruos zombi de el Bandido Keith.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La Arena de las Almas Perdidas, Segunda Parte
programme.desc: El duelo contra el Bandido Keith le va muy mal a Joey. Hasta el último esfuerzo de Joey, su monstruo dichoso Mago del Tiempo, también le falla.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Duelo de Doble Problema, Primera Parte
programme.desc: Joey y Yugi se enfrentan en un duelo contra los Hermanos Paradoja, unos eliminadores de duelistas en el servicio de Pegasus. Pero si no ganan, Yugi y Joey pierderan mucho más que el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Duelo de Doble Problema, Segunda Parte
programme.desc: Los Hermanos Paradoja convocan el monstruo todopoderoso, Guardián de la Puerta, ¡con el poder de reflejar todos los ataques que lanzan Yugi & Joey! No se sabe si Joey esta a ayudando a Yugi…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Duelo de Doble Problema, Tercera Parte
programme.desc: Joey y Yugi pelean con sus monstruos más poderosos, pero su fuerza no es nada contra Gate Guardian. Individualmente, Joey y Yugi no tienen chance, pero ahora ellos preparan para usar el poder más fuerte de todos, ¡la cooperación!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para ganar el derecho de retar a Pegasus a un duelo, Kaiba tendrá que primermente vencer a Yugi y quitarle sus estrellas. ¡Ahora la muy anticipada revancha entre Kaiba Y Yugi comenzara!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca Dragón de Ojos Azules Definitivo, el monstruo mas poderoso en el juego, ¡formado cuando se unen tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules! Yugi ha perdido todos sus monstruos poderosos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a formar una estrategia para terminar con Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules pero tiene que decidir entre ganando el duelo o salvarle la vida a Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus estrellas y la posibilidad de rescatar a su abuelo. Se ha quedado en choque por lo que sucedió en el duelo con Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Campeón contra el Creador, Primera Parte
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos llegan al castillo de Pegasus y descubren que Seto Kaiba duela contra Pegasus para poder rescatar a la alma de su hermano, Mokuba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: El Campeón contra el Creador, Segunda Parte
programme.desc: Kaiba no puede hacer nada contra la bajera Mundo Toon de Pegasus y el poder de su ojo del milenio, siendo humillado y derrotado en el duelo. Al ganar, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Kaiba en una carta, igual como Mokubah y el abuelo de Yugi.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi está resuelto a vencer a Pegasus para salvar su abuelo. Tea, Tristán y Bakura buscan en el castillo de Pegasus para una explicación de sus poderes.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi se desconcentra por la mirada de el Ojo Milenio de Pegasus, y deja que Mai coja una ventaja enorme con su Dragón Mascota de Arpía. ¿Podrá Yugi enfocarse a tiempo, o dejará que la mirada de Pegasus le cueste el duelo?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Después de perderle a Joey, Mai se ha convertido en un duelista mucho mejor. Pero no es cierto si Yugi ha aprendido de su perdida contra Kaiba, o si la emoción de su perdida le están pesando al corazón. ¡La respuesta esta en las tarjetas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: La Maquinación de Keith, Primera Parte
programme.desc: Joey busca la carta que lo permitirá entrar en la batalla final sin saber que el Bandido Keith se la robó. Mientras él está pensando que Serenity se quedará ciega para siempre, ¡recibe ayuda de un amigo nuevo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Las Maquinación de Keith, Segunda Parte
programme.desc: Después que la bajera machina del Bandido Keith hace que Joey juegue defensivo, Joey copia la estrategia del Bandido Keith y convierte su Dragón Azul de Ojos Rojos a metal.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Mejores Duelistas, Mejores Amigos, Primera Parte
programme.desc: Joey reta a Yugi a un duelo para decidir quién tendrá el derecho de enfrentarse a Pegasus. Esta batallla entre amigos se convierte en una lucha fiera entre dos persona que conocen las estrategias y cartas del otro.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Mejores Duelistas, Mejores Amigos, Segunda Parte
programme.desc: Yugi se sorprende cuando Joey usa la carta Time Wizard contra él, porque esa es la carta que Yugi le dió a Joey como señal de su amistad. Pero encuentran confirmación de su amistad que sobrepasa cualquier duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: Yugi Contra Pegasus, el Duelo del Milenio, Primera Parte
programme.desc: Yugi se prepara para el duelo mas increíble de todo el mundo contra Pegasus, ¡con los almas de su abuelo, Kaiba, y Mokubah en riesgo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.desc: Pegasus castiga a Yugi usando la misma baraja Toon y sus habilidades de leer la mente que él usó contra Kaiba. ¿Logrará Pegasus en capturar el alma de Yugi adentro una carta?

programme.title: iCarly: Det spøker på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en leilighet som det sies at det spøker i. Når det begynner å skje nifse ting, begynner også vennene å bli redde for at spøkelsesryktene er sanne.

programme.title: iCarly: En dag jeg vil angre
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet til hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til å gå med på å delta i iCarly. Merkelige ting begynner å gå feil midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies nettvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjensittingen
programme.desc: Sam må sitte igjen den kvelden iCarly holder sin 50. nettvideospesialsending. Carly og Freddie kan da altså ikke gjøre som de pleier, så de prøver så godt de kan å få gjennsitting de også, så de kan sende fra skolebenken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie blir invitert til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de blir tilbudt en stor pengesum får å gå god for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foten, på iCarly. Men det viser seg at skoene er forferdelige.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først
programme.desc: Når Carly og Sam viser interesse for den samme fyren, lover de at han ikke skal komme imellom dem. Men det er vanskelig, og når de slåss om hans oppmerksomhet, blir vennskapet deres satt på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack rat
programme.desc: Carly må trå til når Spencer blir avhengig av et videospil. Sam lurer Freddie til å tro at han blir forfulgt av uhell når han nekter å sende et kjedebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skylder deg en
programme.desc: Sam blir fornærmet når Freddie beskylder henne for ikke å betale ham og Carly noen av de pengene tilbake som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver iherdig å betale dem tilbake - hun finner seg en ordentlig jobb.

programme.title: iCarly: Hubert Lewbert
programme.desc: En "Lur Lewbert"-sketsj går helt galt og skader Carlys irriterende portvakt. Gjengen pleier ham inntil Freddies mor tar over. Men når kærligheten begynner å blomstre, må de sette en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Pie
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Spencer tar med Freddie til deres yndlingskonditori, finner de ut at eieren er død. Men enda verre er det at oppskriftene hans kanskje er gått tapt for alltid.

programme.title: iCarly: Jul
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å pifte opp julen med et utradisjonelt tre, kommer Spencer til å sette fyr på alle Carlys gaver. Fortvilet ønsker hun seg at hun hadde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Kysset
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortelle Carly at han aldri har kysset en jente, og avslører hemmeligheten hans på netshowet. Gibby og Carly trener Spencer til utttaket for det lokale, profesjonelle fotballaget.

programme.title: iCarly: Bilbråk
programme.desc: Gjengen holder en konkurranse på iCarly, og premien er en ny bil fra en lokal forhandler. Etter at Nevel vinner, oppdager barna at forhandleren ikke visste noe om konkurransen eller bilen de skulle ha donert bort som premie.

programme.title: iCarly: Fred
programme.desc: Freddie sier offentlig at han ikke er fan av internettsensasjonen Fred, noe som får Fred til å meddele at han skal slutte å legge ut filmer for alltid. Fansen blir rasende fordi Freddie har forårsaket slutten på de populære filmene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dobbelt opp
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniker seg ut for å dra til en MMA-kamp, får de sine dobbeltgjengere til å lure Spencer til å tro at de fortsatt er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kjempeversjon av Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Om hva for noe?
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie oppfordrer iCarly-fans til å stemme på David Archuleta i "Amerika Sings", syns de synd på nummer to og hjelper ham med å lage en musikkvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg skal gjøre Sam jentete
programme.desc: Da Sam innrømmer at hun liker en gutt på skolen, lærer Carly henne hvordan hun kan lokke ham til seg ved å oppføre seg mere feminint. Spencer er overbevist om at en jente liker ham pga. smokingen hans, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: A date en pøbel del 1
programme.desc: Når Carly dater er en tøffing, prøver hun å holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for å lage en hjemmeside der hun kan legge ut alle sine ekle videofavoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gjenforening med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle venninne Missy flytter tilbake til Seattle, tror Sam at Missy prøver å skifte henne ut som Carlys bestevenninne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg må ha skap 239

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 428

programme.title: Charterfeber

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 408
programme.desc: Denne gangen skal to hytter pusses opp langt inne i Finnskogen. Den ene stram og nordisk, den andre tradisjonell og koselig.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 409
programme.desc: Gutta drar til Telemarks største innsjø, Møsvatn. Hytta de pusser opp ligger på over 900 m.o.h. Her snur de hytta på hodet for å finne den aller beste planløsningen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sesongens siste episode reiser gutta til Harstad for å pusse opp ei hytte for Den Norske Turistforening. Dugnadsånden henger høyt i dette svært spesielle prosjektet, som foregår over mange uker.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 501
programme.desc: For første gang i Eventyrlig oppussings historie reiser gutta utenlands, og til de franske vinranker. Her pusser de opp et sjarmerende feriehus for et norsk par, beliggende i hjertet av Provence.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 502
programme.desc: I sesongens andre episode drar våre oppussingsgenier til en hytte utenfor idylliske Lillesand. Det blir en uforglemmelig uke med et kreativt og overraskende resultat.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 503
programme.desc: Aldri før har gutta tatt fatt på et uidentifiserbart flygende objekt, men akkurat denne uka er det akkurat det de gjør. Se opp for kornsirkler og et rundt håndlaget utekjøkken.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 504
programme.desc: Denne uka tar gutta fatt på en oppussing som eierne ikke har søkt om. På Værøy fyr utenfor Lofoten bruker de seks dager på en oppgave eierne tror vil ta fem til seks år.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 505
programme.desc: Den gamle tømmerkoia på en øy midt i Nordmarka får en kraftig oppgradering og tilpasses til nye generasjoner. Gustav byr på overnatting i sin private tømmerkoie, og Ole tar en skikkelig spansk en.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 506
programme.desc: Et gammelt fiskemottak på Sandøya står foran et ansiktsløft. Her skal de ville kreftene fra Atlanteren få komme til syne inn i bygget, og det blir muligheter for å trekke torsk rett opp fra sofakroken.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 507
programme.desc: En tradisjonell hytte omkranset av mosegrønt rypeterreng er hva gutta bryner seg på denne gangen. Gustav disker opp med et villmarks-spa, mens Ole bygger bord av flere hundre år gamle materialer.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 508
programme.desc: Kalde netter i lavvo og et iskaldt bad under isen er noe av hva du kan se fra Skogn i Trøndelag. En gammel folkehøyskolehytte blir omgjort til familiehytte, og gutta gjør en drastisk omrokkering.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 509
programme.desc: Et gammelt gårdstun fra 1800 tallet på Oppdal i Trøndelag pusses opp. Den gamle bygningen moderniseres uten å fjerne den gode sjelen og følelsen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 510
programme.desc: Ole, Gustav og Halvor pusser opp hver sin rorbu på Træna i Nordland. Her bobler konkurranseinstinktet opp til overflaten, da eierne skal kåre hvilken rorbu de liker best.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 601
programme.desc: Halvor, Ole og Gustav tar turen til øya Fårnøtt i Skjeberg, hvor de møter Deborah og Nils og resten av familien. Gutta forvandler en malplassert fjellhytte til et lyst og skandinavisk paradis ved sjøen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 602
programme.desc: Denne gangen går turen til Tannsjøen i Nord-Odal, der søstrene Kristine og Mari har tatt over en gammel tømmerhytte. Her blir gjengen utfordret på å bygge eget kjøkken, og ett soverom blir til to.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 603
programme.desc: I den lille havnebyen Stavern i Larvik møter vi familien Brekke. Her er det uteområdet som står i fokus. En overgrodd og sjelløs hage gjøres om til en grønn oase med mange soner for enhver aktivitet.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 604

programme.desc: no info available

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2608
programme.desc: Andreas fra Oskarshamn går stadig rundt med dårlig samvittighet overfor foreldrene. To ganger har de reddet ham med et lån, og nå vet de ikke at han nok en gang sitter med gjeld opp over ørene.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2609
programme.desc: 25 år gamle Lina fra Dalarna har nettopp blitt mor for første gang, og ønsker nå en gang for alle å få orden på økonomien.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2610
programme.desc: Niklas fra Dalarna jobber som vei-maler og tjener gode penger. Men interessen hans for biler og lån har satt ham i en situasjon hvor han nå risikerer å miste ALT.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2611
programme.desc: Martin fra Gislaved elsker dingser. Klarna-kontoen hans overstiger 76 000 svenske kroner, og dette er bare ett av syv dyre kredittlån han har. Han er også i ferd med å miste sin kjæreste.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2612
programme.desc: Småbarnsfaren Micael fra Örebro drikker rundt 1000 liter kaffe i året og bruker nesten 30.000 svenske kroner på energidrikker hvert år. Han drømmer også om å ha råd til å ta med barna på ferie.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2613
programme.desc: Susanne og Andreas bor i Timrå med sine tre barn. Ekteskapet holder på å rakne, men i stedet for å lete etter jobb, spiller Andreas dyre mobilspill flere timer om dagen.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2614
programme.desc: Michaela fra Solna får penger av moren hele tiden, som i gjennomsnitt gir henne 15 000 svenske kroner i måneden. Michaela har bodd alene i fire år, men bare en gang har hun betalt husleien selv.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2615
programme.desc: Markus og Veronica har bare vært sammen i to år, men har allerede giftet seg og fått barn. Veronica fikk seg et sjokk da hun fant ut at Markus har stor gjeld.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2616
programme.desc: 50 år gamle Ola fra Eskilstuna har levd et liv i luksus, og later som at han har mer penger enn han egentlig har. Men under overflaten vokser gjelden seg større for hver dag som går.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2701
programme.desc: Lisa lever tilsynelatende et fantastisk familieliv med to barn, et hus og en samboer. Men under overflaten skjuler det seg en stor gjeld og spilleavhengighet som hun har holdt hemmelig for sin partner.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2702
programme.desc: Alexander elsker biler, og i stedet for å tilbringe tid med sin nyfødte sønn, stikker han ofte av i bilen sin. Han spiser enorme mengder sukker og har helt mistet kontrollen over økonomien.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2703
programme.desc: På grunn av angsten sin klarer ikke youtuberen Amanda å gå på jobbintervjuer, og nå er hun redd for å bli hjemløs fordi vennene hennes begynner å bli lei av å gi henne mat og husly.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2704
programme.desc: 21 år gamle Marcus er en ung far som vil være der for barnet sitt. Hans største drøm er å kunne bo sammen med kjæresten og sønnen, samt jobbe som lastebilsjåfør, men i stedet bor han hjemme hos foreldrene sine.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2705
programme.desc: Johan fra Helsingborg unnslipper følelsene sine ved å kjøpe dyre biler. Selv om han er sykemeldt på grunn av depresjon og utmattelse, fortsetter han å kjøpe ting som om det ikke finnes noen morgendag.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2706
programme.desc: 25 år gamle Sanne fra Hjo har aldri vært bra oå økonomi, men da søsteren plutselig døde for drøyt et år siden, ga hun helt opp. Gjelden hoper seg opp, og hun klarer ikke å betale regningene sine.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2707

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: Luksusfellen

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los residentes de South Park se despiertan sin internet. Randy se entera de que en California todavía hay internet, por lo tanto, junto a su familia deciden viajar al oeste del país.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ya que Butters parece encajar tan bien con Cartman, Kyle y Stan, sus padres deciden ir todos juntos a Aspen en un tiempo compartido.

programme.title: South Park
programme.sub-title: La Navidad de Las Criaturas del Bosque
programme.desc: En Navidad, Stan se encuentra con unos animalitos del bosque que le piden favores aparentemente inocentes. Después de embarcarse en una aventura para ayudarlos, Stan descubre que ellos tienen un plan para traer al mundo al anticristo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando un chico mormón se muda a South Park, Stan tiene que patear su trasero, mientras el resto de los ciudadanos están fascinados y se convierten en mormones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un extraterrestre fugitivo pone en riesgo al planeta, Randy y Stan son responsables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de la ciudad están obsesionados con los programas de homicidios de la tv, por lo cual los niños deciden bloquear esos canales.

programme.title: South Park
programme.sub-title: Dos días antes de pasado mañana
programme.desc: Stan y Cartman chocan contra una represa de castores e inundan un pueblo cercano. Como resultado, la ciudad de South Park es declarada en estado de emergencia, ya que todo el mundo piensa que es obra del calentamiento global.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan cumple 10 años y comienza a ver todo de una forma diferente. Para él, ahora todo es una mierda. Los otros chicos lo ven depresivo y se alejan de él para no ser contagiados.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La vida de Stan es un caos en su casa y en la escuela, y tiene que solucionarlo todo por sí mismo. Mientras tanto, el matrimonio Marsh pende de un hilo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se vuelve adicto al nuevo juego móvil de Terrance y Phillip intenta convencer a sus amigos de que es el mejor juego de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan investiga por qué son decorados los huevos de Pascua, y qué tienen que ver los conejos y los huevos con la muerte de Jesús por sus pecados, por lo que se adentra en una sociedad bizarra con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman encuentra una manera única de tratar con el síndrome de Asperger. Mientras tanto, Stan no parece recuperar su vida a la normalidad, no importa cuánto se esfuerce.

programme.title: South Park
programme.sub-title: El gran crucero del Gran Gay Al
programme.desc: Stan tiene un nuevo perro llamado Sparky que resulta ser gay, por lo que todos sus compañeros se burlan de él. Cuando Sparky se va de casa, Stan lo busca en el Santuario de Animales del Gran Gay Al y aprende algo sobre la homosexualidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan cumple 102 años y quiere suicidarse, pero al no poder hacerlo, le pide a Stan que lo ayude.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El abuelo de Stan le regala una corbata que compró en un programa de ventas por 6 mil dólares. Stan trata de venderla en una casa de empeño, pero nadie le ofrece más de 15 dólares.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan intenta borrar su cuenta de Facebook, pero acaba envuelto en el mundo virtual de la red social. Mientras, Kyle agrega a sus amistades a un niño nada popular y comienza a perder amigos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan quiere aumentar la conciencia acerca del bullying y para eso hace un video de baile que se vuelve popular en la escuela. Mientras tanto, Butters es víctima del abuso de su cruel abuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle se obsesionan tanto con Guitar Hero que llegan al punto de romper récords, lo que hace que Stan considere llegar más lejos consiguiendo un compañero diferente.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan no puede parar de guardar cosas innecesarias en su armario y, al ser enviado con el Señor Mackey para tratar su problema, se da cuenta de que él consejero de la escuela tiene el mismo trastorno de acumulación compulsiva que él.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan toca la marihuana que otros chicos mayores dejaron y, por la noche, llega un hombre que dice ser él mismo a los 32 años quién vuelve del futuro, perdido y drogado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van a un restaurante famoso por sus deliciosas alitas y por tener meseras bellas. Butters piensa que ha encontrado a la chica de sus sueños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El pueblo se entera de que los milagros de Jesús se realizaron cuando estaba drogado y todos estan decepcionados de el por lo que quieren liberarse de sus Scausas (Pulseras).

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se convierte en entrenador de un equipo de hockey y trata de hacerlos ganadores. Mientras tanto, su padre tiene que lidiar con el recuerdo de una presentación de Stan en un partido de años atrás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ''Tía Regla'' de Stan le regala un pez dorado que le da mucho miedo y comienzan a haber asesinatos que la mamá de Stan trata de encubrir. Mientras tanto, Cartman se comporta muy extraño de repente y tiene barba.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: The contestants meet journalist Gordon Smart and participate in a press challenge where they write a 60-second skit regarding their opinions of the other contestants, which they later present in front of the camera.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: Letitia, Lisa, and Roxanne receive a second set of makeovers. The contestants meet with Elle at Hyde Park, where they learn that the remaining five contestants will be traveling to Canada for the remainder of the competition.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The remaining five contestants fly to Toronto, where they take on the CN Tower's EdgeWalk before moving into their home at the SoHo Metropolitan Hotel.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: Star of The Hills and America's Next Top Model judge Kelly Cutrone gives the contenders a grilling in Toronto ahead of next week's final.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The contestants head to the National Wedding Show at Birmingham's NEC to be coached in the art of the catwalk by model Jade Parfitt.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Web of Seduction
programme.desc: When investigators found Bruce Miller dead in the office of his junkyard business, the crime scene was almost pristine. But when a computer forensics expert examined computers owned by the victim's wife and her lover, he found all the evidence needed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Making the Collar
programme.desc: The body of 16-year-old Leanne Tiernan was discovered nine months after she disappeared. Forensic scientists found clues that painted a virtual portrait of her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Financial Downfall
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman falls to her death from a cliff overlooking the ocean. Initially, investigators think it was a tragic accident. But after a forensic examination, police uncover a very different picture of what happened.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over a Barrel
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cries Unheard
programme.desc: A 19-year-old woman was found dead in her car; the scene had been staged to make murder appear to be suicide. During their investigation, police discovered the victim was involved in a love quadrangle, giving several people a motive to kill her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Buried Treasure
programme.desc: A man disappears one year to the day after beginning an affair with his friend's wife. 15 years later, with the help of a metal detector, police find evidence that would prove what had happened and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Obsession
programme.desc: Power is a responsibility as well as a privilege. But in the wrong hands, power can corrupt. For former Deputy Attorney General for the State of Delaware, losing sight of his sworn oath to uphold justice could prove lethal.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Backstage Murder
programme.desc: In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Første hjemmekamp

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programme.desc: I seriens siste episode, forbereder Dallas Cowboys' heiagjeng seg for entréopptredenen sin - Susan G. Komen Cancer Awareness Halftime Show - under en nasjonalt overført Cowboys' footballkamp.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Drømmer står på spill når uttaket til 2013-2014 Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders innledes. Når portene åpnes og 500 jenter stimer inn, er den spenningen til å ta og føle på. Konkurransen kommer til å være steinhard.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Return of the Vets
programme.desc: Presset er enormt når 54 nye kandidater konkurrerer mot 32 veteraner om en invitasjon til den berømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders-treningsleiren.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Pressure to Perform
programme.desc: Treningsleiren begynner i Cowboys berømte treningslokaler, Valley Ranch. Det første møtet er fullt av spenning og energi til Kelli kaller inn til spesialmøte med veteranene.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Harsh Reality
programme.desc: "Treningsleirens skumleste kveld" innledes med en dramatisk hendelse når jentene lærer de fryktede hoppspagatene. Det er bare å kjempe seg gjennom for jentene som prøver seg på det berømte og nødvendige trinnet.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Appearance Counts
programme.desc: DCC-makeover-dagen er kritisk for noen av jentene. Kelli får seg noen store overraskelser og Jinelle opplever noe skummelt. Tessa avslører resultatet av hennes legebesøk før en tøff dansetrening.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Toxic Situation
programme.desc: Treningsleirkandidatene holder pusten når den unike Kitty Carter besøker treningsleiren. Kitty holder ikke tilbake når hun skjeller ut så vel nybegynnere som veteraner.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Pressure Cooker
programme.desc: De siste jentene sendes snart hjem og noen som er i faresonen må lære seg den berømte DCC-entréen, men treningen øker ikke akkurat deres sjanser til å komme på laget.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Game Day
programme.desc: Jentene har en siste sjanse før deres skjebne avgjøres. Drømmer begynner å bli til virkelighet når jentene poserer for lagbildet. Det bys på fantastisk dans når show-gruppen og resten av troppen opptrer for første gang.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: The Journey Begins
programme.desc: Følg med og se hvem som kommer til å klare de vanskeligste danseuttakene i sportsverdenen. 500 kvinner satser alt for drømmen om å bli en av de berømte Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders for 2014-2015-sesongen.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Dancing For Your Life
programme.desc: 55 jenter i toppklasse har kommet seg til finalen, noe som bekymrer de 30 veteranene som nå må kjempe for en plass i troppen. Kitty Carter holder ikke tilbake når hun forbereder jentene på å danse sine soloer.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Welcome to Valley Ranch
programme.desc: Når treningsleiren åpner med 43 kvinner, blir presset stort! Kellis entusiasme er smittsom, men det første møtet er også opprørende. Forventningene er skyhøye. Syv jenter må eliminieres for at troppen skal bestå av 36.

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: A Week Of Firsts

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: James Fairweather
programme.desc: James Fairweather is no ordinary teenager in 2014. Most his age don't choose the dark, violent games and websites that James does as he returns from school, retreats behind the bedroom door.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Mark Martin
programme.desc: Mark Martin made no secret of the fact that when he grew up he wanted to be a serial Killer. The Krays, Donald Neilson, Ian Brady all serial killers, were his childhood heroes.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Shawn Grate
programme.desc: Shawn was a good looking boy, and he learnt that he could turn on a smile and get what he wanted. He was popular with women but often in trouble for abusing them. He was sent to prison at 22 for choking his pregnant girlfriend.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Malcolm Webster
programme.desc: Nurse Malcolm Webster was convicted for the murder of his first wife, Claire Morris. For 17 years it was believed to be an accident; until he staged another 'road accident' in New Zealand, involving his second wife, Felicity Drumm.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Vickie Dawn Jackson
programme.desc: Vickie Dawn Jackson was described as sweet and 'gone to fat' by locals in her small Texas town. Why did Vickie kill off the friends and relatives of those whom she knew in Nocona, Texas?

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Jeannie Miata
programme.desc: Jeannie Miata was a nurse who killed a woman with a lethal dose of insulin. Experts analyse the actions and motive of this disturbing murderer.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Roger Dean
programme.desc: On November 18, 2011, Roger Dean, a nurse at Quakers Hill Nursing Home in Sydney, Australia murdered 11 elderly residents after setting fire to the facility as they slept in a bid to hide evidence of his theft of painkillers.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Donald Harvey
programme.desc: Harvey is notable for having used numerous methods to kill, including arsenic; cyanide; suffocation; miscellaneous poisons; morphine; turning off ventilators.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Megan Haines
programme.desc: Megan Haines, South African immigrant and mother of a dangerous and disaffected son, carries out a murderous rampage against the elderly in the quiet coastal town of Ballina, New South Wales.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Garry Davis
programme.desc: Gary Davis told his Facebook friends that 'I hate old people' and days before two patients in his care were found dead, he predicted they would die.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Anne Grigg-Booth
programme.desc: Anne Grigg-Booth, who was responsible for administering painkilling injections to patients, was a heavy drinker with a passion for drugs. We hear from the doctor that Grigg-Booth's team lined up as an expert witness in her defence.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Elizabeth Wettlaufer
programme.desc: Wettlaufer, 49, of Ontario, intentionally administered fatal doses of drugs to her victims, aged 75 to 96, between 2007 and 2014. After killing, she would post some of her dozens of verses. Wettlaufer's victims included five women and three men.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Efren Saldivar
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period. Quickly christened an "Angel of Death," he targeted patients who were already near death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Karen Pedley
programme.desc: The case of care home worker Karen Pedley who was given 14 life sentences in 2016. Deeply affected by a fire at her home when she was a child, Pedley developed into a pyromaniac.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Sandra Weir
programme.desc: The story of Sandra Weir, who acted as a carer for her elderly neighbor. But she was stealing from the pensioner to fund her drug addiction, leading to a tragic confrontation.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Paul Novak
programme.desc: The case of New York paramedic Paul Novak, who boasted of committing the perfect murder after the dust had settled on the death of his first wife Catherine.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Paul Novak
programme.desc: The case of New York paramedic Paul Novak, who boasted of committing the perfect murder after the dust had settled on the death of his first wife Catherine.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thomas Dunkley
programme.desc: The case of carer Thomas Dunkley, who aided boxer Shaun 'The Guv'nor' Cummins after he became paralysed, and later killed and dismembered his patient.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thomas Dunkley
programme.desc: The case of carer Thomas Dunkley, who aided boxer Shaun 'The Guv'nor' Cummins after he became paralysed, and later killed and dismembered his patient.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Beverley James
programme.desc: The story of debt-ridden mother-of-three and night-time sex worker Beverley James. By day, she was meant to care for Harriet Davison, a frail woman she beat to death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thelma Purchase
programme.desc: Care worker Thelma Purchase plotted with her son and a friend to murder disabled Greg Baker who Purchase once worked for. She knew he couldn't defend himself and she stood to be a beneficiary in his will.
